cc0e1b960_vault_balance_exceeds_target.meaning: the vault balance exceeds the target so a buffer excess exists
cc0e1b960_vault_balance_exceeds_target.evidence: `rebalanceFunds()` in `FastAccessVault` is declared `external` and lacks any role or ownership check, despite the interface documenting it as owner-only. When the vault balance exceeds the target, the function transfers the full excess to the custodian address. Because no caller restrictions or rate limits exist, any account can invoke it repeatedly whenever the buffer is above target, forcing excess liquidity off-chain and reducing instant redemption capacity. The vulnerable logic is between lines 164-180 of `FastAccessVault.sol`. 【F:src/protocol/FastAccessVault.sol::L164-L180】【F:src/protocol/interfaces/IFastAccessVault.sol::L139-L145】
